summary_ja: LSMSのINT8ベースFP64エミュレーションを追加調査しました。GB200 NVL4・FeNi3・2 SCF反復では高精度modeの対象行列反転が平均約1.7倍と報告されましたが、31 bit modeはSCF収束に失敗しました。GEMMul8の再利用にはmatrix不変性等の契約があり、SCILIB-Accelも現時点ではNVIDIA・coherent memory中心です。投稿中preprintであり、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update examines INT8-based FP64 emulation in LSMS. On GB200 NVL4 with FeNi3 and two SCF iterations, high-precision modes report about 1.7x for the targeted matrix inversion, while the 31-bit mode fails SCF convergence. GEMMul8 reuse has matrix-immutability and configuration contracts, and SCILIB-Accel currently centers on NVIDIA coherent-memory systems. The paper is a submitted preprint, and Consensus is incomplete.

sections.title_ja: 実applicationでのINT8ベースFP64エミュレーション
sections.title_en: INT8-based FP64 emulation in a scientific application
sections.summary_ja: LSMSの物理量、収束、演算誤差、対象kernel性能を分け、低精度matrix engineをFP64計算へ用いる条件を整理します。
sections.summary_en: Separate physical observables, convergence, arithmetic error, and target-kernel performance in using low-precision matrix engines for FP64 computation.

items.name_ja: LSMS：GB200上でINT8からFP64 GEMMを再構成
items.name_en: LSMS: reconstructing FP64 GEMM from INT8 on GB200
items.timing_en: March 2026 submitted preprint and public implementations
items.statement_ja: 2026年3月の投稿中preprintは、MuSTのLSMSをSCILIB-AccelでGPUへ自動offloadし、GEMMul8またはCUDA 13のOzaki方式でFP64 GEMMをINT8系matrix engineから再構成しています。FeNi3、GB200 NVL4、33,750×33,750の倍精度complex matrix、2 SCF反復において、高精度GEMMul8 modeの対象行列反転はnative FP64比で平均約1.7倍と報告されています。これはapplication全体、複数node、energy、他材料への速度倍率ではありません。
items.statement_en: A March 2026 submitted preprint automatically offloads MuST LSMS through SCILIB-Accel and reconstructs FP64 GEMM on INT8-class matrix engines using GEMMul8 or CUDA 13 Ozaki methods. For FeNi3 on a GB200 NVL4 node, a 33,750-by-33,750 double-complex matrix, and two SCF iterations, it reports about 1.7x for the targeted matrix inversion in high-precision GEMMul8 modes over native FP64. This is not a whole-application, multi-node, energy, or cross-material speedup.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: AI向け低精度比率が高いGPUを科学計算へ使う候補ですが、procurement評価では対象kernel比率とend-to-end速度を分離できます。
items.hpci_relevance_en: This is a candidate path for scientific use of AI-oriented GPUs, but procurement evaluation should separate target-kernel share from end-to-end speedup.
adoption_conditions_ja: 複数材料、matrix size、SCF回数、node数でend-to-end時間とenergyを測る。
native FP64、algorithmic mixed precision、Ozaki-I、Ozaki-IIを同一条件で比較する。
offload、data placement、emulationの寄与を個別に測る。
adoption_conditions_en: Measure end-to-end time and energy across materials, matrix sizes, SCF counts, and node counts.
Compare native FP64, algorithmic mixed precision, Ozaki-I, and Ozaki-II under matched conditions.
Measure the separate contributions of offload, data placement, and emulation.

items.name_ja: LSMS：物理量の一致とSCF収束は別条件
items.name_en: LSMS: matched observables and SCF convergence are distinct conditions
items.timing_en: March 2026 submitted preprint and public implementations
items.statement_ja: 同preprintでは31 bit/10 moduli modeでGreen関数の最大相対誤差が約10^-2となり、total energyがFP64表示値に近くてもSCF収束に失敗しました。55 bit/16 moduliではGreen関数誤差が約10^-10、より高精度modeはelectron densityの10^-6自己無撞着条件を満たし、energy、磁気moment、電荷がFP64 baselineと一致したと報告します。LSMSのcontour integrationとDFT変分性による誤差抑制は、任意のapplicationへ一般化できません。
items.statement_en: In the same preprint, the 31-bit or 10-moduli mode reaches about 10^-2 maximum relative error in the Green function and fails SCF convergence even though the displayed total energy remains close to FP64. The 55-bit or 16-moduli mode reaches about 10^-10 Green-function error; higher-precision modes satisfy the 10^-6 electron-density self-consistency condition and match FP64 energy, magnetic moments, and charges. Error suppression from LSMS contour integration and DFT variational behavior cannot be generalized to arbitrary applications.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 科学的合否は最終scalar値だけでなく、収束、内部量、感度、再現性を組み合わせる必要がある実例です。
items.hpci_relevance_en: This demonstrates that scientific acceptance needs convergence, internal quantities, sensitivity, and reproducibility in addition to final scalar outputs.
adoption_conditions_ja: domain expertが物理量・収束・誤差許容値を事前定義する。
失敗modeを除外せず、速度と失敗確率を同時に報告する。
入力perturbation、compiler、GPU、実行順序に対する感度を確認する。
adoption_conditions_en: Have domain experts predefine physical quantities, convergence, and error tolerances.
Retain failed modes and report speed together with failure probability.
Check sensitivity to input perturbations, compilers, GPUs, and execution order.

items.name_en: GEMMul8 and SCILIB-Accel: reuse contracts and platform constraints
items.timing_en: March 2026 submitted preprint and public implementations
items.statement_ja: GEMMul8は前処理済みINT8/FP8表現をworkspaceに保持して再利用できますが、matrix内容、形状、operation、moduli数、fast mode、backendが不変である必要があり、内容変更をlibrary自身は検査しません。SCILIB-Accelは現時点でNVIDIA GPUのみをsupportし、S2/S3 data movementはGrace-Hopperのcoherent memoryを前提とします。source変更不要という特徴は、platform非依存や無条件の正しさを意味しません。
items.statement_en: GEMMul8 can retain preprocessed INT8 or FP8 representations in workspace for reuse, but matrix contents, shape, operation, modulus count, fast mode, and backend must remain unchanged; the library does not validate matrix contents. SCILIB-Accel currently supports NVIDIA GPUs only, and its S2/S3 data-movement modes assume Grace-Hopper coherent memory. No-source-change integration does not imply platform independence or unconditional correctness.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 導入時はbinary interceptionの容易さだけでなく、memory model、workspace、変更検知、thread/process安全性、fallbackを評価します。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Adoption should assess memory model, workspace, mutation detection, thread/process safety, and fallback rather than binary interception alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: matrix変更を検知できないskip modeをdefault採用しない。
CUDA/ROCm、coherent/discrete GPU、MPI rank共有で同じ機能を仮定しない。
adoption_conditions_en: Do not enable skip modes that cannot detect matrix mutation by default.
Measure workspace capacity and fallback under out-of-memory conditions.
Do not assume parity across CUDA/ROCm, coherent/discrete GPUs, or shared MPI ranks.
